accepted.note: Accepted. TP19 HEAT_EN, TP20 PUMP_NODE and TP22 COIL_DRV sit 1.75 mm from the board edge, inside the 2.0 mm the fixture wall wants. The wall is relieved locally at those three positions rather than the pads moved: they are charge-pump and coil-drive nodes whose routing is deliberate (SYS-SAF-02), and a relief is cheaper than re-laying that corner. Check the relief against the printed 1:1 SVG before ordering the fixture.

Accepted. VBUS is the USB input, upstream of the regulator, and is not a rail the firmware depends on: +5V (TP1) and +3.3V (TP2) are both probed and are what prove the board came up. A VBUS pad would only tell us the USB cable is plugged in, which the fixture knows because it is the thing plugged in.

_comment: Findings on the DUT that have been looked at and accepted, each with the reason. PS031 (one ground test point) and PS050 (no mounting holes) are deliberately NOT here: they are the two findings that say the fixture cannot work yet, they are the same problem seen twice, and a baseline that absorbed them would hide it. See fixture/README.md.
